session_note: Michigan's 104th Legislature covers the 2025-2026 term (through December 2026); Michigan bills carry over between the two years of the same term without needing reintroduction (a bill introduced in 2025 remains the same live bill in 2026). As of the research date the Legislature has not adjourned sine die - it is in summer recess (House adjourned until 2026-08-11, Senate until 2026-08-12, per legislature.mi.gov), so no bill below is 'died' or 'carried_over'; unpassed bills are simply still in_committee and legitimately pending.
